topic: Why Shiva manifested as Bhairava to sever Brahma's fifth head — Shiva Purana, Shatarudra Samhita. Lesson: Intellectual superiority paired with ego creates falsehood that demands immediate ego-death.
title: Brahma Ka Paanchwa Sir Kyun Kata?

problems: scene 1: The caption 'AUR SHIVA NE UNKA' does not match the intended script line 'Brahma ji ne ek jhooth bola... aur Shiva ne unka sir hi kaat diya!'.
scene 2: The caption 'AUR VISHNU MEIN LADAI' does not match the intended script line 'Shuruat mein Brahma aur Vishnu mein ladai chhid gayi ki sabse bada kaun hai.'.
